test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A circular clock has the hour hand of length 6 inch. Find the length of the distance it covers by it's tip from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m.
solution:
**Given:**

Length of hour hand = 6 inch.

**Concept Used:**

Arc length = 2πrθ/360° 

**Calculation:**

Hours taken from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m. = 6 hours.

In 6 hours, hour hand complete half round means makes 180° angle.

The radius of the circle = 6 inch

Length of the distance it covers by it's tip from 9 p.m. to 3 a.m makes arc.

Arc length = 2πrθ/360° 

⇒ (2π × 6 × 180)/360° = 6π inch

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**
